guidetextdraw._value: INSTRUCTIONS: Please attach a legible copy of your DD214 to document your status as a veteran of the United States Armed Forces. Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1649757256910

guidetextdraw_1865830146._value:
A “veteran” is defined as one of the following:

  1. Someone who has engaged in active duty in the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, or Coast Guard.
  2. A member of the National Guard or Reserves who was called to active duty for purposes other than training.
  3. A cadet or midshipman at one of the service academies and was released under a condition, other than dishonorable.
guidetextdraw_1865830146.name: textdraw_18658301461667563783490
